content: Adults with type 1 diabetes should receive comprehensive education on how to appropriately adjust their insulin doses to match their carbohydrate intake. This education is essential for optimizing glycemic control and minimizing the risk of hypoglycemia. In addition to carbohydrate intake, other factors must be taken into account when determining insulin dosing. These factors include the intake of fat and protein, current blood glucose levels, anticipated physical activity, and the presence of any illness.
